notes.title: Deru - The Art of Cooperation now available on PC / Mac / Linux and Nintendo Switch
notes.content:
You will never be so puzzled about something so seemingly simple!

https://youtu.be/oNEar75mEvQ

It is the November 7th DERU is finally at your virtual doorstep!

We are bursting with excitement to share DERU on Steam and Nintendo Switch with you and thank you for staying with us until now. 

Aaaand it’s 10% off! Hurray!  

DERU is all about inviting your friends over, getting comfy on the couch and share an amazing time together. Join the the movement, get DERU and your buddies into one room and enjoy teamplay, puzzle solving and LOOOOOOVE!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/283a1ab33cdf2fb9d1caa32e4f2db3464ea4fd40.jpg

Spread the word and let’s boost DERU to the front pages of those stores!
 
How?
Do the Twitter every retweet helps!
Leave a review on Steam ! ( a lot actually :) )
Do the Facebook sharing is caring!
Surprise your cat and your hamster with the game! ( they might like it )
Join our Discord.


Online Co-op

And another thing. Sometimes your best friend is out of town but you’d like to enjoy some good co-op gaming. For these situations we found a solution to still be able to co-op together: Parsec. Read the how to here

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/afa892aea1f149d6a304738a395cc6fcff14719c.jpg

All the best, happy co-opearting and thanks a lot!

Christian, Dominik, Melanie and Sam

notes.title: Release date annouced: 7th November 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30695794/04317c19413bf09a3422314fc28dc233e3781c4c.jpg

DERU - The Art of Cooperation ready to bend minds on November 7th

DERU is, finally after years of development and promises of release dates, coming to Steam ( on PC, Mac and Linux) and Nintendo Switch on November 7th.

We are really happy ( like really really happy ) that we can finally show you the game in its final state and not a event-made version! 


Check out the accouncement trailer!
https://youtu.be/nIjTm-K9zh0

Deru, the awards winning co-op experience designed by Ink Kit will finally come out on Nintendo Switch and PC on November 7th after 4 years of development. In this couch co-op game, two players must team up to overcome deadly streams of shadow and light only through teamwork, timing, and tactics.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/632250/extras/Deru_Scale.png?t=1539961780


The Art of Cooperation

Watch out for those circle streams! In Deru, the players must block streams, split themselves and juggle their mass to solve together mind-bending puzzles where communication and brains fusing will bring their co-op gaming skills to the next level. The visuals are deeply connected to the puzzles and the result are gorgeous simplistic levels whose solution is probably more than just one corner away.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/632250/extras/Deru_Split.png?t=1539961780


Soon the cooperation can begin <3!

Inkkit Team
